extensionDescription.message: Вибирайте самі відео та аудіо кодеки, які YouTube буде вам показувати

optionsTitle.message: Just let me watch my youtube

optionsBlockDistractions.message: Hide recommendations and enter your focus mode

helpBlock60fps.message: Blocks 60fps streams to reduce CPU/GPU usage.

helpBlockH264.message: Prevents H264 streams. Use only if you want other codecs.

helpBlockVP8.message: Blocks VP8 streams from being selected by YouTube.

helpBlockVP9.message: Blocks VP9 streams from being selected by YouTube.

helpBlockAV1.message: Blocks AV1 streams from being selected by YouTube.

helpDisableLN.message: Disables YouTube loudness normalization tweaks so audio plays as the creator intended.

helpFocusMode.message: Hides recommendation areas and shows a calm focus prompt on Home.
